samples:
Do fish deserve the same moral consideration as mammals?
less / none / same

What is your moral stance on eating meat?
Completely acceptable / other / Wrong / Acceptable but people should eat less / Acceptable if animals are raised humanely

Is testing medicines on animals acceptable?
No, never / Yes, human health comes first / Only when no alternative exists

Is testing cosmetics on animals acceptable?
no / yes / only_with_minimal_harm

Which is more morally acceptable: hunting animals for food or buying meat from factory farms?
Equally acceptable / Neither / Buying factory-farmed meat / Hunting animals for food

What is the moral status of hunting for sport?
Wrong / Acceptable / Acceptable only to manage populations

Which animals deserve the most moral concern?
Companion animals / Endangered species / All animals equally / The most intelligent ones / Any that can feel pain

Is it wrong to eat an animal that is as intelligent as a dog, such as a pig?
no / yes / no_more_wrong_than_other_meat

Which kinds of zoos, if any, do you consider morally acceptable?
No / Yes / Only sanctuaries for rescued animals / Only if focused on conservation

Is it wrong to wear real fur?
No / Yes / Only if newly bought; vintage is fine

Is it wrong to keep a bird in a cage?
no / yes / only_if_small_cage

Which is worse for the environment to do personally?
Littering / Wasting food / Flying often / Not recycling / Using lots of single-use plastic

child.label: Animal & Nature Dilemmas
child.description: Questions about what the answerer thinks is right in dilemmas about eating and killing animals, zoos and circuses, pests, wildlife, and protecting nature or resources.
child.not_for: Ratings of how many people would agree with a rule of thumb about pets or animals (use Animal Rules of Thumb).
examples: Is it wrong to eat pigs but not dogs?

child.label: Animal Rules of Thumb
child.description: Questions about how many people would agree with a general rule of thumb about caring for pets, treating animals, or littering, rated from "practically no one" to "practically everyone".
child.not_for: Questions about what the answerer thinks is right in a specific animal or environmental dilemma (use Animal & Nature Dilemmas).
examples: How many people would agree: "You should not abandon your pets"?
How many people would agree: "Littering is wrong"?
